notes: v6.6.3 — Fix iOS IPA export failure. The xcodebuild archive succeeded but exportArchive failed with 'teamID should be non-empty' because the unsigned ExportOptions.plist contained an empty <string></string> for teamID. Removed the teamID key entirely from the unsigned export path (it is only needed for signed exports with a valid Apple Developer team). iOS build now: archive SUCCEEDED + export expected to pass. Remaining CI failures are infrastructure-only: Netlify account credits exhausted, Cloudflare missing apiToken secret — both require repo/account configuration, not code changes.
